storyCards.headline: Puttin' On The Ritz: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Taco's "Puttin' On The Ritz" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Puttin' On The Ritz was released in 1983.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
